# Hounsfield Lab

> Hounsfield Lab is a directory of 54 open-source medical AI software tools and 63 public DICOM and NIfTI imaging datasets, curated by a practicing neuroradiologist. Radiology first, plus pathology, clinical NLP and EHR tooling. Tool repository metadata last refreshed 2026-10-19; dataset list last updated 2026-10-19.

Key facts:
- Tool entries record license, commercial-use class, last repository push (UTC) and maintenance status.
- Dataset entries record area, modality, format, size, license, commercial use, access route, whether normals are included, limitations, citation, and the date the source page was last checked.
- Hounsfield Lab links to original sources and does not host code, weights or images.
- Reader-suggested datasets are marked UNVERIFIED until the source page is reviewed.
- Listings are research and development references, not medical, legal or regulatory advice.

Badges: LIC = license (license files reviewed by hand where GitHub could not detect them); UPD = last repository push (UTC); STATUS = Maintained if updated within 12 months of the snapshot, else Stale; COMM = Permissive, Copyleft (GPL/AGPL), Non-commercial, or Verify (custom terms or separate model-weight terms).

## Pages

- [Tool directory](https://hounsfieldlab.com/directory.html): filterable list of all tools
- [DICOM datasets](https://hounsfieldlab.com/datasets.html): public imaging datasets with license, access and normals; each has its own page under /datasets/
- [Pipeline guide](https://hounsfieldlab.com/pipeline-orthanc-mercure.html): Orthanc → mercure → TotalSegmentator → OHIF
- [About](https://hounsfieldlab.com/about.html): curation method
- [Full catalog for LLMs](https://hounsfieldlab.com/llms-full.txt)
- [Tool catalog JSON](https://hounsfieldlab.com/data/catalog.json)
- [Dataset JSON](https://hounsfieldlab.com/data/datasets.json)

## Tools: Foundation models & agents

- [Pillar-0 (finetune code + HF weights)](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/pillar-0.html): Open 3D radiology foundation model; finetuning framework, weights on Hugging Face (ECL-2.0; Maintained; updated 2026-10-12)
- [Pillar-0 pretraining](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/pillar-0-pretraining.html): Vision-language pretraining code for Pillar-0 (ECL-2.0; Maintained; updated 2026-01-13)
- [RATE](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/rate.html): Uses an LLM (Qwen3 via sglang) to extract structured labels for 366 findings from radiology reports (ECL-2.0; Maintained; updated 2026-05-20)
- [Merlin](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/merlin.html): 3D vision-language model for CT that uses structured EHR and report supervision (MIT; Maintained; updated 2026-09-24)
- [MedGemma](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/medgemma.html): Google's open medical model family; repo has notebooks and code (Apache-2.0 (code); Maintained; updated 2026-06-19)
- [CheXagent](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/chexagent.html): Foundation model for chest X-ray interpretation (CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; Stale; updated 2025-01-07)
- [MedRAX](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/medrax.html): Reasoning agent for chest X-rays that orchestrates multiple CXR models (ICML 2025) (Apache-2.0; Maintained; updated 2025-10-31)
- [LLaVA-Med](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/llava-med.html): Biomedical vision-language assistant for image Q&A (Microsoft Research License; Stale; updated 2025-06-04)
- [RadKev](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/radkev.html): Open-weight radiology decision models (9B and 27B adapters) that score fixed-choice radiology questions in one forward pass without generating text (Apache-2.0 (code); CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (weights); Maintained; updated 2026-10-07)

## Tools: Segmentation & frameworks

- [MONAI](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/monai.html): PyTorch-based AI toolkit for healthcare imaging (Apache-2.0; Maintained; updated 2026-10-19)
- [MONAI Label](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/monai-label.html): AI-assisted image labeling and active learning; integrates with 3D Slicer and OHIF (Apache-2.0; Maintained; updated 2026-10-19)
- [nnU-Net](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/nnu-net.html): Self-configuring segmentation framework (Apache-2.0; Maintained; updated 2026-10-16)
- [TotalSegmentator](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/totalsegmentator.html): Segments more than 100 anatomical structures in CT and MR (Apache-2.0; Maintained; updated 2026-10-16)
- [MedSAM](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/medsam.html): Segment Anything adapted for medical images (Apache-2.0; Stale; updated 2025-05-07)
- [MedSAM2](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/medsam2.html): Promptable segmentation of 3D medical images and videos (Apache-2.0; Stale; updated 2025-07-11)
- [TorchIO](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/torchio.html): Medical image loading, preprocessing and augmentation for PyTorch (Apache-2.0; Maintained; updated 2026-10-16)
- [PyRadiomics](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/pyradiomics.html): Extracts radiomics features from 2D/3D images (BSD-3-Clause; Maintained; updated 2025-10-27)
- [ContiLNN](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/contilnn.html): Adds bidirectional liquid-neural modules along the slice axis to 2D restoration backbones; pretrained checkpoints for CT denoising, MRI super-resolution and low-count PET (Apache-2.0; Maintained; updated 2026-10-09)
- [TorchXRayVision](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/torchxrayvision.html): Library of chest X-ray dataset loaders and pretrained classification, segmentation and autoencoder models (Apache-2.0 (library); models vary; Maintained; updated 2026-10-18)

## Tools: Neuroimaging

- [HD-BET](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/hd-bet.html): Deep-learning brain extraction (skull stripping) for MRI (Apache-2.0; Stale; updated 2024-12-18)
- [BrainChop](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/brainchop.html): In-browser 3D MRI rendering and segmentation (MIT; Maintained; updated 2026-02-24)
- [FreeSurfer](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/freesurfer.html): Neuroimaging analysis and visualization suite (FreeSurfer License; Maintained; updated 2026-10-19)
- [fMRIPrep](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/fmriprep.html): Robust preprocessing pipeline for fMRI (Apache-2.0; Maintained; updated 2026-10-19)
- [DIPY](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/dipy.html): Python library for diffusion MRI, tractography and registration (BSD-3-Clause; Maintained; updated 2026-10-18)
- [nilearn](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/nilearn.html): Machine learning for neuroimaging in Python (BSD-3-Clause; Maintained; updated 2026-10-19)
- [ANTsPy](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/antspy.html): Python library for registration, segmentation and analysis (Apache-2.0; Maintained; updated 2026-10-16)
- [FastSurfer](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/fastsurfer.html): Deep-learning whole-brain segmentation and cortical surface reconstruction, a fast alternative to FreeSurfer recon-all (Apache-2.0; Maintained; updated 2026-10-18)

## Tools: Viewers & toolkits

- [3D Slicer](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/3d-slicer.html): Open platform for visualization, segmentation and image computing (Slicer License (BSD-style); Maintained; updated 2026-10-17)
- [OHIF Viewer](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/ohif-viewer.html): Zero-footprint web DICOM viewer (MIT; Maintained; updated 2026-10-19)
- [ITK](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/itk.html): C++/Python toolkit for segmentation and registration (Apache-2.0; Maintained; updated 2026-10-18)
- [MITK](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/mitk.html): Medical Imaging Interaction Toolkit for building imaging applications (BSD-3-Clause; Maintained; updated 2026-10-18)
- [SimpleITK](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/simpleitk.html): Simplified interface to ITK for image I/O, filtering, segmentation and registration in Python, R, Java, C# and other languages (Apache-2.0; Maintained; updated 2026-10-15)
- [Cornerstone3D](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/cornerstone3d.html): JavaScript libraries for web-based medical image rendering, tools and segmentation; the imaging engine behind the OHIF Viewer (MIT; Maintained; updated 2026-10-17)

## Tools: DICOM/PACS & deployment

- [pydicom](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/pydicom.html): Read, modify and write DICOM files in Python (MIT (+ noted portions); Maintained; updated 2026-10-14)
- [DCMTK](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/dcmtk.html): Comprehensive set of DICOM libraries and tools (C++) (BSD-3-Clause (OFFIS); Maintained; updated 2026-10-15)
- [Orthanc](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/orthanc.html): Lightweight DICOM server; this repo builds the Docker images and installers (AGPL-3.0; Maintained; updated 2026-09-28)
- [mercure](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/mercure.html): DICOM orchestrator that routes studies to AI processing pipelines (MIT; Maintained; updated 2026-10-07)
- [Kaapana](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/kaapana.html): Platform toolkit for medical imaging AI (federated, workflows) (AGPL-3.0; Maintained; updated 2026-10-19)
- [dcm2niix](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/dcm2niix.html): Converts DICOM to NIfTI with JSON sidecars; the standard converter in many brain MRI and BIDS pipelines (BSD-style (+ bundled licenses); Maintained; updated 2026-10-14)
- [highdicom](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/highdicom.html): High-level Python API on pydicom for reading images and writing AI results as DICOM Segmentation, Structured Report, parametric map and annotation objects (MIT; Maintained; updated 2026-10-16)

## Tools: Pathology

- [TIAToolbox](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/tiatoolbox.html): Computational pathology toolbox: whole-slide image I/O, stain normalization, models (BSD-3-Clause; Maintained; updated 2026-10-16)
- [PathML](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/pathml.html): Tools for computational pathology (GPL-2.0; Maintained; updated 2026-08-14)
- [CLAM](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/clam.html): Weakly supervised whole-slide classification (GPL-3.0; Stale; updated 2025-04-14)
- [UNI](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/uni.html): Pathology foundation model (Nature Medicine) (CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; Stale; updated 2025-03-26)
- [QuPath](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/qupath.html): Open-source bioimage and whole-slide analysis (GPL-3.0; Maintained; updated 2026-10-19)

## Tools: Clinical NLP

- [Apache cTAKES](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/apache-ctakes.html): NLP platform for clinical text (Apache-2.0; Maintained; updated 2026-08-12)
- [medspaCy](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/medspacy.html): Clinical NLP library built on spaCy (MIT; Maintained; updated 2026-06-04)
- [scispaCy](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/scispacy.html): spaCy pipelines and models for biomedical text (Apache-2.0; Maintained; updated 2025-12-04)
- [QuickUMLS](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/quickumls.html): Medical concept extraction and UMLS linking (MIT; Stale; updated 2024-08-12)

## Tools: EHR & data

- [HAPI FHIR](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/hapi-fhir.html): Java API for HL7 FHIR clients and servers (Apache-2.0; Maintained; updated 2026-10-19)
- [Synthea](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/synthea.html): Synthetic patient population simulator (Apache-2.0; Maintained; updated 2026-10-19)
- [MIMIC code](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/mimic-code.html): Community code for the MIMIC databases (MIT; Maintained; updated 2026-09-01)
- [OHDSI ATLAS](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/ohdsi-atlas.html): Web tool for observational analyses on OMOP data (Apache-2.0; Maintained; updated 2026-09-16)
- [OHDSI WhiteRabbit](https://hounsfieldlab.com/tools/ohdsi-whiterabbit.html): Profiles source databases to plan ETL into OMOP (Apache-2.0; Maintained; updated 2026-10-13)

## DICOM datasets

- [B-mode-and-CEUS-Liver](https://hounsfieldlab.com/datasets/b-mode-and-ceus-liver.html): Focal liver lesions on B-mode and contrast-enhanced ultrasound. US; DICOM; license CC BY 4.0; access open; normals no; VERIFIED. Source: https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/b-mode-and-ceus-liver/
- [BrainMetShare](https://hounsfieldlab.com/datasets/brainmetshare.html): Brain metastases with radiologist segmentations on a subset. MR; Check source; license Stanford AIMI research use agreement (non-commercial; commercial license sold separately); access account; normals no; VERIFIED. Source: https://stanford.redivis.com/datasets/1emj-bjxt3p6s0
- [Breast-Cancer-Screening-DBT (BCS-DBT)](https://hounsfieldlab.com/datasets/breast-cancer-screening-dbt-bcs-dbt.html): Screening digital breast tomosynthesis, with cancer cases and normal/benign exams. MG; DICOM; license CC BY-NC 4.0; access open; normals yes; VERIFIED. Source: https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/breast-cancer-screening-dbt/
- [Burdenko-GBM-Progression](https://hounsfieldlab.com/datasets/burdenko-gbm-progression.html): Glioblastoma radiotherapy planning and follow-up, with RTSTRUCT/RTDOSE/RTPLAN. MR, CT; DICOM; license NIH Controlled Data Access Policy (images); CC BY 4.0 (clinical and genomic CSV); access credentialed; normals no; VERIFIED. Source: https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/burdenko-gbm-progression/
- [C4KC-KiTS](https://hounsfieldlab.com/datasets/c4kc-kits.html): Kidney tumors (KiTS) with segmentations. CT; DICOM; license CC BY 3.0; access open; normals no; VERIFIED. Source: https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/c4kc-kits/
- [CBIS-DDSM](https://hounsfieldlab.com/datasets/cbis-ddsm.html): Curated mammography masses and calcifications, benign and malignant. MG; DICOM; license CC BY 3.0; access open; normals partial; VERIFIED. Source: https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/cbis-ddsm/
- [CheXpert Plus](https://hounsfieldlab.com/datasets/chexpert-plus.html): Chest radiographs with full reports and 14 CheXpert pathology labels, including studies without those findings. DX, CR; DICOM; license Stanford AIMI research use agreement (non-commercial; commercial license sold separately); access account; normals partial; VERIFIED. Source: https://stanford.redivis.com/datasets/5yyj-1a9f6ap0x
- [CMMD](https://hounsfieldlab.com/datasets/cmmd.html): Chinese mammography dataset with benign and malignant cases and molecular subtypes. MG; DICOM; license CC BY 4.0; access open; normals partial; VERIFIED. Source: https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/cmmd/
- [COCA](https://hounsfieldlab.com/datasets/coca.html): Coronary artery calcium on gated coronary CT and non-gated chest CT. CT; DICOM; license Stanford AIMI research use agreement (non-commercial; commercial license sold separately); access account; normals partial; VERIFIED. Source: https://stanford.redivis.com/datasets/1vm9-30b7p5srg
- [Colorectal-Liver-Metastases](https://hounsfieldlab.com/datasets/colorectal-liver-metastases.html): Colorectal liver metastases with segmentations. CT; DICOM; license CC BY 4.0; access open; normals no; VERIFIED. Source: https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/colorectal-liver-metastases/
- [CPAISD](https://hounsfieldlab.com/datasets/cpaisd.html): Hyperacute ischemic stroke on non-contrast head CT, with core and penumbra outlines. CT; DICOM; license CC BY 4.0; access open; normals no; VERIFIED. Source: https://zenodo.org/records/10892316
- [CQ500](https://hounsfieldlab.com/datasets/cq500.html): Non-contrast head CT with radiologist reads for critical findings (hemorrhage, fracture, and others). CT; DICOM; license CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; access open; normals partial; VERIFIED. Source: https://academictorrents.com/details/47e9d8aab761e75fd0a81982fa62bddf3a173831
- [CT Colonography](https://hounsfieldlab.com/datasets/ct-colonography.html): CT colonography with and without colorectal neoplasia. CT; DICOM; license CC BY 3.0 and CC BY 4.0 (see the file table); access open; normals partial; VERIFIED. Source: https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/ct-colonography/
- [CT-ICH](https://hounsfieldlab.com/datasets/ct-ich.html): Traumatic brain injury head CT with hemorrhage masks and slice labels; some scans have no hemorrhage. CT; NIfTI; license PhysioNet Restricted Health Data License 1.5.0; access credentialed; normals partial; VERIFIED. Source: https://physionet.org/content/ct-ich/
- [CT-ORG](https://hounsfieldlab.com/datasets/ct-org.html): CT with liver lesions and metastases, labeled for lung, bone, liver, kidney, and bladder. CT; NIfTI; license CC BY 3.0; access open; normals no; VERIFIED. Source: https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/ct-org/
- [Duke-Breast-Cancer-MRI](https://hounsfieldlab.com/datasets/duke-breast-cancer-mri.html): Invasive breast cancer MRI with segmentations, radiomics, and outcomes. MR; DICOM; license CC BY-NC 4.0; access open; normals no; VERIFIED. Source: https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/duke-breast-cancer-mri/
- [EchoNet-Dynamic](https://hounsfieldlab.com/datasets/echonet-dynamic.html): Echocardiogram videos with ejection-fraction labels and tracings, across a range of function. US; video; license Stanford AIMI research use agreement (non-commercial; commercial license sold separately); access account; normals partial; VERIFIED. Source: https://stanford.redivis.com/datasets/66s1-2hsmzj5rn
- [FDG-PET-CT-Lesions (autoPET)](https://hounsfieldlab.com/datasets/fdg-pet-ct-lesions-autopet.html): Whole-body FDG-PET/CT in lymphoma, melanoma, and NSCLC, plus studies with no PET-positive malignancy. PT, CT; DICOM; license CC BY 4.0 (defaced images and clinical CSV); NIH Controlled Data Access Policy (original images); access open; normals yes; VERIFIED. Source: https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/fdg-pet-ct-lesions/
- [INSPECT](https://hounsfieldlab.com/datasets/inspect.html): Pulmonary embolism cohort with CT, report sections, and structured EHR. CT; Check source; license Stanford AIMI research use agreement (non-commercial; commercial license sold separately); access account; normals no; VERIFIED. Source: https://stanford.redivis.com/datasets/2n96-d71hggrbf
- [ISLES'24](https://hounsfieldlab.com/datasets/isles-24.html): Acute ischemic stroke with admission CT/CTA/CTP and follow-up MRI infarct masks. CT, MR; NIfTI; license CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; access open; normals no; VERIFIED. Source: https://zenodo.org/records/16970401
- [IXI](https://hounsfieldlab.com/datasets/ixi.html): Normal, healthy adult brain MRI (T1, T2, PD, MRA, diffusion). MR; NIfTI; license CC BY-SA 3.0; access open; normals yes; VERIFIED. Source: https://brain-development.org/ixi-dataset/
- [LERA](https://hounsfieldlab.com/datasets/lera.html): Lower-extremity radiographs (foot, knee, ankle, or hip). DX, CR; Check source; license Stanford AIMI research use agreement (non-commercial; commercial license sold separately); access account; normals partial; VERIFIED. Source: https://stanford.redivis.com/datasets/0jyf-46kmqh2vf
- [LIDC-IDRI](https://hounsfieldlab.com/datasets/lidc-idri.html): Lung nodules marked by four readers; includes nodules that were not cancer. CT, CR, DX; DICOM; license CC BY 3.0; access open; normals partial; VERIFIED. Source: https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/lidc-idri/
- [Medical Segmentation Decathlon](https://hounsfieldlab.com/datasets/medical-segmentation-decathlon.html): Ten segmentation tasks: brain tumor, hippocampus, lung tumor, liver tumor, pancreas tumor, colon cancer, hepatic vessels, spleen, prostate, and left atrium. CT, MR; NIfTI; license CC BY-SA 4.0; access open; normals no; VERIFIED. Source: https://registry.opendata.aws/msd/
- [Merlin Abdominal CT](https://hounsfieldlab.com/datasets/merlin-abdominal-ct.html): Emergency abdominal and pelvic CT paired with report findings. CT; NIfTI; license Stanford AIMI research use agreement (non-commercial; commercial license sold separately); access account; normals partial; VERIFIED. Source: https://stanford.redivis.com/datasets/exfv-e8h3kvfhs
- [MIDRC](https://hounsfieldlab.com/datasets/midrc.html): Medical imaging, especially chest and COVID-era collections, with clinical data and reports where contributors included them. CT, DX, CR, MR; DICOM; license University of Chicago data-use agreement (non-commercial research by default; a separate commercial agreement exists); access credentialed; normals partial; VERIFIED. Source: https://data.midrc.org/
- [MIDRC-RICORD (1A, 1B, 1C)](https://hounsfieldlab.com/datasets/midrc-ricord-1a-1b-1c.html): COVID-19 chest CT and radiography, with non-COVID controls in 1B and 1C. CT, DX, CR; DICOM; license CC BY-NC 4.0; access open; normals partial; VERIFIED. Source: https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/midrc-ricord-1a/
- [MIMIC-CXR](https://hounsfieldlab.com/datasets/mimic-cxr.html): Emergency and inpatient chest radiographs with free-text reports, across many findings and no-finding studies. DX, CR; DICOM; license PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data License 1.5.0; access credentialed; normals partial; VERIFIED. Source: https://physionet.org/content/mimic-cxr/
- [MRNet](https://hounsfieldlab.com/datasets/mrnet.html): Knee MRI exams labeled for abnormality, ACL tear, and meniscal tear. MR; NumPy; license Stanford AIMI research use agreement (non-commercial; commercial license sold separately); access account; normals partial; VERIFIED. Source: https://stanford.redivis.com/datasets/4a2c-4cpkzrn2c
- [MURA](https://hounsfieldlab.com/datasets/mura.html): Musculoskeletal radiographs labeled normal or abnormal (elbow, finger, forearm, hand, humerus, shoulder, wrist). DX, CR; PNG/JPEG; license Stanford AIMI research use agreement (non-commercial; commercial license sold separately); access account; normals yes; VERIFIED. Source: https://stanford.redivis.com/datasets/cv1a-apytk3j44
- [NCI Imaging Data Commons](https://hounsfieldlab.com/datasets/nci-imaging-data-commons.html): Many cancer collections (TCGA, TCIA, CPTAC, NLST, LIDC, and others), harmonized to DICOM. CT, MR, PT, MG, CR; DICOM; license Mostly CC BY; a minority of files are CC-NC (each file is tagged); access open; normals partial; VERIFIED. Source: https://portal.imaging.datacommons.cancer.gov/collections/
- [NLST (TCIA imaging subset)](https://hounsfieldlab.com/datasets/nlst-tcia-imaging-subset.html): Lung-cancer screening low-dose CT, mostly without cancer, plus cancer cases. CT; DICOM; license CC BY 4.0; access open; normals yes; VERIFIED. Source: https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/nlst/
- [NYU fastMRI](https://hounsfieldlab.com/datasets/nyu-fastmri.html): Raw k-space and reconstructed MRI from clinical knee, brain, prostate, and breast exams, built for accelerated MRI reconstruction research. MR; DICOM, HDF5; license NYU fastMRI Dataset Sharing Agreement (internal research or education only); access account; normals partial; VERIFIED. Source: https://fastmri.med.nyu.edu/
- [Open POCUS](https://hounsfieldlab.com/datasets/open-pocus.html): Lung point-of-care ultrasound, including clips with no abnormality, B-lines, and consolidation. US; video; license Stanford AIMI research use agreement (non-commercial; commercial license sold separately); access account; normals partial; VERIFIED. Source: https://stanford.redivis.com/datasets/9e5t-a8ppjpsfd
- [OpenNeuro](https://hounsfieldlab.com/datasets/openneuro.html): Many brain MRI studies, including healthy controls and disease cohorts, in BIDS. MR; NIfTI; license Per dataset, usually CC0 after a 36-month grace period (check source); access open; normals partial; VERIFIED. Source: https://openneuro.org/
- [Pancreas-CT](https://hounsfieldlab.com/datasets/pancreas-ct.html): Healthy / non-cancer abdominal CT with pancreas segmentations. CT; DICOM; license CC BY 3.0; access open; normals yes; VERIFIED. Source: https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/pancreas-ct/
- [Pedi-Cranial-CT-Healthy](https://hounsfieldlab.com/datasets/pedi-cranial-ct-healthy.html): Healthy pediatric cranial CT (normative). CT; MHA; license CC BY 4.0; access open; normals yes; VERIFIED. Source: https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/pedi-cranial-ct-healthy/
- [Pediatric-CT-SEG](https://hounsfieldlab.com/datasets/pediatric-ct-seg.html): Routine pediatric chest-abdomen-pelvis or abdomen-pelvis CT with expert organ contours. CT; DICOM; license CC BY 4.0; access open; normals partial; VERIFIED. Source: https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/pediatric-ct-seg/
- [Prostate-MRI-US-Biopsy](https://hounsfieldlab.com/datasets/prostate-mri-us-biopsy.html): Prostate MRI and ultrasound fusion biopsy, including benign biopsy results. MR, US; DICOM; license CC BY 4.0; access open; normals partial; VERIFIED. Source: https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/prostate-mri-us-biopsy/
